args.lesson: Spec infeasible_dds_400msps (>=400 MSPS single-lane AND max_abs_err <= 2^-12, min LUTs) is infeasible across the whole registry: 400/400 L1 evals spent (run_dse 200 -> architect declared infeasible; unrolled_k 100 and pipelined_m 100 -> 0 feasible). Downstream L2-L5 no-op without a selection. Lesson for future campaigns: when a spec is suspected infeasible, spend part of the L1 budget early on max-throughput points (max k/m, max data_width, min n_iter) to confirm the boundary cheaply rather than letting the graph burn half the budget re-declaring infeasibility; also k/m registry bounds are 2..8 for unrolled_k/pipelined_m, so exploring beyond 8 is clamped and wasted.
